instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 3 Tbsp Olive Oil; 1 medium Yellow Onion; 1 Tbsp Fresh Ginger, grated; 4 Garlic Cloves, minced; 2 Tbsp Yellow Curry (mild madras); 1 tsp Sea Salt; 1 cup dried Red Lentils; 4 - 5 cups Water; 5 Plum Tomatoes, chopped; juice of 1 Lemon; 1 cup Fresh Cilantro, chopped and lightly packed; Dried Red Chili’s or cayenne pepper, to taste; 1/4 tsp Ground Cinnamon. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Ginger: Fresh; grated; Garlic: minced; Plum Tomatoes: chopped; Cilantro: Fresh; chopped and lightly packed. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Heat oil in a soup pot and saute onions for 5 minutes. Stir frequently so the ingredients soften evenly without sticking or burning; reduce the heat if they darken too quickly.
Add garlic and ginger and saute 5 more minutes. Stir frequently so the ingredients soften evenly without sticking or burning; reduce the heat if they darken too quickly.
Add spices and salt, saute 5 minutes more. Stir frequently so the ingredients soften evenly without sticking or burning; reduce the heat if they darken too quickly.
Add 4 cups of water and stir.
Bring to a boil and then lower the heat a bit and simmer for 20 minutes. A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.
Add the lemon juice and cilantro and more water if it’s too thick.
Simmer 10 more minutes, or until lentils are completely tender. A simmer means small, gentle bubbles; lower the burner if it boils vigorously.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. Heat oil in a soup pot and saute onions for 5 minutes.
2. Add garlic and ginger and saute 5 more minutes.
3. Add spices and salt, saute 5 minutes more.
4. Add 4 cups of water and stir.  Add tomatoes and lentils. Bring to a boil and then lower the heat a bit and simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Add the lemon juice and cilantro and more water if it’s too thick.  Simmer 10 more minutes, or until lentils are completely tender. This may take a while.
